prompts.title: 1. Photo Restoration
prompts.body: Bring this aged photograph back to life using period-appropriate restoration. Identify when it was taken and which photographic process produced it so the rebuild stays historically faithful. Tighten blurred contours, ease out grain, and fill lost regions with textures native to the original. Reintroduce missing color in a measured, era-appropriate way – never neon, never plastic. Re-balance whites, blacks, and skin tones for natural lighting; lift shadows and tame highlights without flattening the image. Quietly reconstruct eroded detail – fabric weave, skin pores, distant scenery – while leaving the framing untouched. Keep gentle film grain for character, strip artefacts but preserve the era's soft exposure profile. Finally, upscale to a clean modern resolution so the result reads as a freshly developed photograph rather than a digital effect.
prompts.note: Best for historically faithful restoration of aged or damaged photographs.

prompts.title: 2. Body Reshape
prompts.body: Recompose the body in this image to match [TARGET BUILD – e.g. lean and athletic, slimmer waist, longer legs, more muscular, softer figure, etc.]. Preserve believable anatomy and proportion, keep skin tone and surface texture consistent with the original, and let the lighting on the new body match the lighting that was already on the rest of the scene. The retouch must read as one continuous photograph – no warped surroundings, no smeared edges, no cut-out feel – just the same person in the same shot with their physique adjusted.
prompts.note: Best for realistic physique adjustments that preserve the original photo context.
variables: TARGET BUILD – e.g. lean and athletic, slimmer waist, longer legs, more muscular, softer figure, etc.

prompts.title: 3. Remove Watermarks
prompts.body: Treat the underlying photo as untouchable and strip away only the overlaid logos, captions, or graphic marks sitting on top of it. The recovered image must remain identical beneath – no redrawn faces, no altered hair or skin, no shifted expression, no rearranged limbs, no new background. Just the source photo, cleanly free of overlays.
prompts.note: Best for removing visible overlays while keeping the original image unchanged.

prompts.title: 6. 4K Enhancer
prompts.body: High-resolution upscale anchored to the source – zero deviation in face, identity, expression, pose, framing, and scene. Recover natural detail (pores, hair, fabric) without stylization. Keep colors, lighting, and contrast exact. Strip compression artifacts and noise while preserving authentic texture – no smoothing, no plastic skin, no identity drift, no hallucinated detail. Output: a photorealistic upscale – only clearer and sharper.
prompts.note: Best for sharper source-faithful upscales without identity drift.

Make it look like a true low-resolution handheld camera image, with tiny resolution, only 4 greenish tones, strong dithering, coarse dot patterns, heavy pixelation, simplified shadows, and a raw monochrome portable-camera look. The final result should feel ugly, limited, and graphic, not polished pixel art, not smooth digital art, and not a modern retro illustration. Mood, [MOOD].

prompts.title: Magazine Scan, Tabloid Gossip Style
prompts.body:
Use the uploaded photo as the subject reference. Turn this person into [ROLE] featured inside a crowded tabloid gossip magazine page about [SCANDAL OR STORY]. Keep their likeness recognizable, but make the final image feel like a chaotic printed celebrity gossip spread, not a clean editorial portrait. Place them in [SCENE], [ACTION], wearing [OUTFIT], surrounded by loud headlines, cropped paparazzi-style photos, arrows, circles, stickers, price tags, captions, gossip callouts, and messy page graphics.

Make it look like a real scanned tabloid magazine page, with cheap glossy paper texture, halftone dots, saturated ink, slightly faded print, scanner softness, compression artifacts, overlapping text boxes, dramatic pull quotes, red circles, yellow labels, and cluttered layout energy. The page should feel noisy, sensational, and overdesigned, like a 2000s supermarket gossip magazine. Mood, [MOOD].
prompts.note: Best for chaotic 2000s celebrity gossip spreads with headlines, arrows, and scan texture.

prompts.title: Vintage Sepia
prompts.body:
Use the uploaded photo as the identity reference. Recreate this person as [ROLE] in an old sepia photograph set in [SCENE]. They are [ACTION], posed like a formal or candid photo from the late 1800s or early 1900s. Keep their face and recognizable features consistent, but adapt their outfit to [OUTFIT] and add [EXTRA DETAILS] that feel historically aged and natural.

Make the image look like a true vintage sepia photograph, with warm brown monochrome tones, faded contrast, soft focus, subtle scratches, paper stains, worn edges, gentle vignette, uneven exposure, and old photographic texture. Avoid modern sharpness, bright colors, clean digital skin, or glossy AI polish. Mood, [MOOD].
prompts.note: Best for late-1800s or early-1900s sepia photos with worn paper texture.

prompts.title: 4. Professional Portrait
prompts.body: Take the casual reference photo and rebuild it as a polished executive-grade headshot. Reframe to head-and-shoulders against a clean seamless studio backdrop, swap whatever the subject is wearing for a sharp tailored suit, crisp dress shirt, and a subtle tie. Direct the gaze straight into the lens with a confident closed-mouth smile and an upright squared posture. Light it like a high-end studio: a large soft key from above camera-left, gentle fill, a quiet rim to separate them from the backdrop, with clean catchlights in both eyes. Hold an 85mm portrait look with the backdrop softly out of focus. Preserve real skin texture – pores, fine lines, age – without plastic smoothing. Keep the original face identity, age, ethnicity, hair, and beard intact; only the wardrobe, framing, lighting, and backdrop change.
prompts.note: Best for turning casual references into polished professional headshots.

prompts.title: 5. Famous Selfie
prompts.body: Casual phone selfie shot, both subjects from the reference images crowded close together at the lens, leaning into the frame from each side, holding the phone at arm's length with a slight upward tilt. Easy shoulder-to-shoulder framing, eyes straight into the camera, relaxed everyday expressions. Soft mixed indoor light cutting against direct phone-flash, with mild blown highlights and natural shadow falloff on the faces. Skin reads real – visible pore detail, faint pore-level texture, subtle makeup if any, the odd flyaway hair, minor fabric crease. The setting sits softly behind them, slightly out of focus, with everyday environmental detail still readable. A touch of edge motion blur from a moving hand, gentle lens distortion from how close the phone is, off-center crop, hint of ISO grain, white balance not perfectly clean. Unfiltered, unposed, candid realism – looks like a quick phone snap, not a styled portrait.
prompts.note: Best for candid two-person phone selfies with unpolished realism.

prompts.title: World Cup VIP Cutaway
instructions: Attach the subject image first.
Attach the scoreboard reference image if using one.
prompts.body:
Create a photorealistic candid live football broadcast cutaway using the uploaded subject image only as the exact facial identity reference. Preserve the subject’s face, skin tone, age, facial proportions, distinctive features, gender presentation, ethnicity, hairstyle and modesty. If the subject wears a headcover, do not reveal hair or neck. Do not copy the original pose, head tilt, expression or camera angle; rebuild everything naturally.

Scene: FIFA World Cup 2026 [match stage] match between [home team] and [away team] at [stadium] in [venue location], with the subject supporting [supported team]. The subject is inside a premium VIP hospitality suite behind a clear glass railing, overlooking the pitch.

Outfit: official [supported team] national team jersey, elegant dark navy blazer or cardigan, black trousers, FIFA style event lanyard, slim watch, small [supported team] scarf draped naturally.

The subject is unaware of the camera, fully focused on the match. Frame waist up. Body turned about 45 degrees toward the pitch, head upright and facing the same direction, neck straight, shoulders balanced. Gaze directed toward the right side of frame, slightly downward toward the pitch. No eye contact with camera. Expression is tense and hopeful, eyebrows slightly tightened, lips slightly parted, as if watching a final minutes [supported team] attack.

Pose: both hands rest lightly on the clear glass railing with natural relaxed fingers. No thumbs up, waving, peace signs or camera facing gestures.

Include 5 supporting spectators around the subject, partially cropped at the left and right edges, wearing [home team] and [away team] jerseys or refined matchday clothing. Everyone looks naturally toward the pitch. Add softly blurred heads, shoulders, scarves and raised hands in the lower foreground for stadium depth, without blocking the subject’s face.

Show subtle glass reflections, dark suite framing, premium stadium architecture and softly blurred crowd background. Reflections must stay light and never cover the face.

Camera and lighting: authentic distant live sports broadcast angle, 200mm to 400mm telephoto compression, natural asymmetrical composition. Face and eyes sharp, surrounding spectators slightly softer. Realistic stadium lighting with soft VIP suite ambient light and reflected pitch light. Natural skin texture, realistic fabric folds, mild live broadcast compression.

Add a compact professional football broadcast scoreboard at the top left, using the uploaded scoreboard image as the visual style reference. Text: [scoreboard text]. Design: small white rounded timer box with bold black text, dark charcoal team boxes, accurate flag icons, bold uppercase three letter team codes [home team code] and [away team code], bright cyan score boxes with large black numbers, small central white rounded box with a black and gold tournament trophy icon, compact connected broadcast graphics, sharp and readable. Do not add “LIVE.” Do not cover the subject’s head or face.

Final image must look like a real spontaneous spectator cutaway from a live FIFA World Cup 2026 television broadcast, not a studio portrait, fashion shoot, ad, CGI or illustration. Photorealistic, realistic anatomy, natural hands and fingers, accurate facial identity, 4K broadcast quality, aspect ratio 3:4.
prompts.note: Best for identity-preserving live football spectator cutaways with broadcast scoreboard graphics.

prompts.title: The Anatomy of an Agent Prompt
prompts.body:
Goal
Define exactly what the agent is being asked to accomplish. A strong goal includes the main task, important constraints, and the outcome you expect, so the agent knows what success looks like from the start

Return format
Specify how you want the agent to present its work. This can include the information to return, how many options to provide, what details to include for each one, and whether it should stop for approval before taking the next action

Warnings
Set clear boundaries around what the agent should never do. These instructions are especially useful for purchases, payments, sensitive data, security risks, or any action where a mistake could have real consequences

Context dump
Give the agent the background information that helps it make better decisions.
This can include why the task matters, previous problems, preferences, operational details, and anything else that would change how it approaches the job

Example

I want you to buy 40 ergonomic office chairs for our new San Francisco office, under $20,000 total.

Each chair should be highly rated for all-day comfort and arrive within two weeks.

For each option, return the chair model, the merchant, the merchant’s Baselayer verification status, price per chair, total cost, delivery date, and why it’s a good fit.

Return the top 3, then wait for my approval before checking out.

Only buy from Baselayer-verified merchants. Present our Baselayer identity credential at checkout so the order isn’t flagged as bot activity. Never enter our card on a site that fails counterparty verification.

For context: we’re a 40-person fintech team moving into a new office next month. last quarter an intern’s agent ordered monitors from a storefront that turned out to be registered four days earlier -- we never saw the monitors or the money again. finance is now nervous about letting agents spend anything. we sit at our desks 8+ hours a day, so comfort matters way more than looks. our last chairs came from a big-box retailer that kept blocking our agent’s checkout as a bot, so we ended up finishing the order by hand. if this goes smoothly, it’s the proof finance needs to let agents handle all of our office procurement.
prompts.note: Structure an agent prompt with a goal, return format, warnings, and context dump.

prompts.title: Structure Prompts with Symbols
prompts.body:
1. # — Give it a heading
Give each part of your prompt a clear heading.

# Role
You are a marketing expert.
# Task
Write a launch email for a new productivity app.

A clear heading tells the reader what comes next.

2. ### — Break it into steps
Break a larger task into smaller, named sections.

## Task
Build a launch plan.
### First
Define the target audience.
### Second
Draft three key messages.

Headings show hierarchy. Number steps when order matters.

3. * — Make every rule clear
Put each requirement on its own line.

Rules:
* Write concisely.
* Avoid jargon.
* Use three bullet points.
* Keep the tone friendly.

One requirement per line. Easier to read and review.

4. Quotation marks — Show what to rewrite
Separate the text to edit from your instructions.

Rewrite this for a business audience:
"Our new app helps teams finish their work faster."

Keep your instructions outside the quoted text.

5. --- — Separate the context
Create a visible boundary between instructions and context.

Summarize the notes below.
Treat them as source text.
---
Background notes:
[paste your notes here]
---

Label your source text as clearly as your task.

6. [] — Make it reusable
Make a prompt reusable with replaceable placeholders.

Write an email for [industry] about [offer].
Audience: [audience]
Tone: [tone]
Length: [word count]

Swap the placeholders. Keep the prompt.

7. | — Ask for a table
Show the columns you want in a Markdown table.

Organize this into a table.
Use these columns:
| Item | Details | Priority |

Name the columns. Request a table explicitly.

Put it all together
A prompt you can adapt in seconds.

# Role
You are a recruiter.
## Task
Rewrite my CV for [job title].
### Requirements
* Keep it to one page.
* Use numbers where supported.
* Do not invent facts.
### Output
Return the CV, then a table:
| Change | Reason |
My CV: "[paste your CV here]"
Job: "[paste job description]"
prompts.note: Use headings, lists, quotes, context boundaries, placeholders, and tables, with a complete CV example.

prompts.title: 6. Kill the Invisible Tracking
prompts.body:
Deleting the list isn’t enough. Two switches keep profiling you in the background.

In Settings, Personalization, turn off Reference Chat History, the hidden layer with no list you can ever see.

Then go to Data Controls and TURN OFF “Improve the model for everyone” so your chats stop training future models. Memory and training are separate toggles, flip both.
prompts.note: Best for completely disabling background tracking and model training.
